42014100.note_zh: 表 7.1 中甘精胰岛素 U-100 的低谷时间和作用时长曾误沿用旧版指南的数值，现已更正为低谷 5–6 小时、作用时长 11–12 小时。
42014100.quote: Corrigendum: Bugbee A, Rucinsky R, Alvarez E, Cook A, Lathan P, Panning C. 2026 AAHA Diabetes Management Guidelines for Cats. J Am Anim Hosp Assoc. 2026;62(3):65-93. doi:10.5326/JAAHA-MS-7572. Upon reviewing the manuscript, the authors found that the nadir and duration values for insulin glargine U-100 in Table 7.1 had been inadvertently carried over from a previous guidelines edition. The numbers in Table 7.1 have been corrected to a nadir of 5-6 hr and duration of 11-12 hr.
